title: Beginner-Intermediate Pottery & Raku Firing Workshops
commitment: 1-day workshops (4 hours each) plus raku firing at First Saturday Open House
bring: Clothes that can get dirty and/or an apron
summary: Two-part raku workshop where you throw or handbuild pieces, then fire them in raku at one of Catalyst's monthly First Saturday events. Ages 10+.
how_to_join: Register through website; registration dates not stated
source_quote:
Beginner-intermediate; Ages 10+
1-day workshops (register for each separately):
- Sun, Sept 13, 1:00pm - 5:00pm
- Fri, Sept 18, 10:00pm - 2:00pm
- Mon, Oct 5, 6:00pm - 10:00pm
- Sat, Oct 24, 2:00pm - 6:00pm
- Fri, Nov 13, 10:00am - 2:00pm
- Sat, Nov 21, 2:00pm - 6:00pm
evidence_sentence: Students make raku-ready pieces in class, then fire them during one of Catalyst's monthly First Saturday raku firings.
evidence_quote: Your registration also includes a raku firing during one of our First Saturday raku firings of your choosing
